listing.name: Battle Hunter — Battle Hunter Recompiled (salman95)
listing.summary: The project reports a playable launcher with music, gamepad support and upscaling. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-01335 CUE/BIN, keeping the CUE and its referenced tracks together.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s portable ZIP or AppImage player and select your own matching disc at launch.

warnings: The project reports a playable launcher with music, gamepad support and upscaling. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
